deadline.value: All application materials are due December 1 (once a year, Fall admission only).

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is required; if you cannot take it for reasons beyond your control you may apply with a future test date and an explanation.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Math Subject Test: Required for both PhD and MS programs.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; students pick an advisor by the beginning of the third year.
supervisor.quote: By the beginning of the third year, students select an advisor specializing in their major area.

funding.value: Financial support is typically provided for up to 6 years; apply by the December 1 deadline to be considered for support.
funding.quote: Financial support is typically provided for up to 6 years

also.quote: To be considered for admission and financial support, applicants need to complete their application by the deadline of December 1st for Fall admission.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 (or IELTS 7, or a WHED English-medium degree); TA employment needs TOEFL Speaking 26+ or IELTS Speaking 8+.
toefl_min.quote: International applicants must submit a TOEFL score of minimum IBT 80, or IELTS minimum 7

ielts_min.quote: International applicants must submit a TOEFL score of minimum IBT 80, or IELTS minimum 7

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Entry route is not stated on the pages checked.
